import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd();
+
+def write_project(name, source):
+    root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'fozzylang-{name}-'))
+    (root / 'src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (root / 'fozzy.toml').write_text(textwrap.dedent(f'''\
+        [package]
+        name="{name}"
+        version="0.1.0"
+
+        [[target.bin]]
+        name="{name}"
+        path="src/main.fzy"
+    '''))
+    (root / 'src/main.fzy').write_text(textwrap.dedent(source))
+    return root
+
+def verify(name, source, expect_rc):
+    root = write_project(name, source)
+    proc = subprocess.run(['cargo', 'run', '-q', '-p', 'fz', '--', 'verify', str(root), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
+    payload = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
+    assert proc.returncode == expect_rc, (name, proc.returncode, payload, proc.stderr)
+    return payload
+
+def messages(payload):
+    return [item['message'] for item in payload['items']]
+
+plain_helper_reuse = verify('plain_helper_reuse', '''
+    fn consume(p: *mut u8) -> i32 {
+        free(p)
+        return 0
+    }
+    fn main() -> i32 {
+        let p = alloc(32)
+        discard consume(p)
+        free(p)
+        return 0
+    }
+''', 1)
+assert any('uses moved value `p` after move/consume' in message for message in messages(plain_helper_reuse)), plain_helper_reuse
+assert any('consumes non-owned or already-consumed value `p` via `free`' in message for message in messages(plain_helper_reuse)), plain_helper_reuse
+
+task_handle_reuse = verify('task_handle_reuse', '''
+    use core.thread;
+    fn worker() -> i32 {
+        return 1
+    }
+    fn finish(handle: TaskHandle) -> i32 {
+        return join(handle)
+    }
+    fn main() -> i32 {
+        let handle = spawn(worker)
+        discard finish(handle)
+        discard join(handle)
+        return 0
+    }
+''', 1)
+assert any('uses moved value `handle` after move/consume' in message for message in messages(task_handle_reuse)), task_handle_reuse
+
+http_handle_reuse = verify('http_handle_reuse', '''
+    use core.http;
+    fn respond(conn: HttpHandle) -> i32 {
+        return http.write_json(conn, 200, "{}")
+    }
+    fn main() -> i32 {
+        let conn = http.accept()
+        discard respond(conn)
+        discard http.write_json(conn, 200, "{}")
+        return 0
+    }
+''', 1)
+assert any('uses moved value `conn` after move/consume' in message for message in messages(http_handle_reuse)), http_handle_reuse
+
+proc_handle_reuse = verify('proc_handle_reuse', '''
+    use core.proc;
+    fn close_handle(handle: ProcessHandle) -> i32 {
+        return proc.close(handle)
+    }
+    fn main() -> i32 {
+        let argv = proc.argv_new()
+        let env = proc.env_new()
+        let handle = proc.spawn_cmd("echo", argv, env, "")
+        discard close_handle(handle)
+        discard proc.close(handle)
+        return 0
+    }
+''', 1)
+assert any('uses moved value `handle` after move/consume' in message for message in messages(proc_handle_reuse)), proc_handle_reuse
+assert any('consumes non-owned or already-consumed value `handle` via `proc.close`' in message for message in messages(proc_handle_reuse)), proc_handle_reuse
+
+stream_handle_reuse = verify('stream_handle_reuse', '''
+    use core.http;
+    fn close_stream(stream: HttpStreamHandle) -> i32 {
+        return http.stream_close(stream)
+    }
+    fn main() -> i32 {
+        let stream = http.post_json_stream("https://example.com", "{}")
+        discard close_stream(stream)
+        discard http.stream_close(stream)
+        return 0
+    }
+''', 1)
+assert any('uses moved value `stream` after move/consume' in message for message in messages(stream_handle_reuse)), stream_handle_reuse
+
+task_group_reuse = verify('task_group_reuse', '''
+    use core.thread;
+    fn worker() -> i32 {
+        return 1
+    }
+    fn finish(group: TaskGroupHandle) -> i32 {
+        return task.group_join_all(group)
+    }
+    fn main() -> i32 {
+        let group = task.group_begin()
+        discard task.group_spawn(group, worker)
+        discard finish(group)
+        discard task.group_cancel(group)
+        return 0
+    }
+''', 1)
+assert any('uses moved value `group` after move/consume' in message for message in messages(task_group_reuse)), task_group_reuse
+assert any('task group `group` is terminated multiple times (task.group_join_all via finish, task.group_cancel)' in message for message in messages(task_group_reuse)), task_group_reuse
+
+print('compiler-memory-post-consume-wrappers-ok')
